audio.title: Ludwig van Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor
audio.body: Listen to the complete orchestral performance of Beethoven's legendary 5th Symphony, widely regarded as one of the most famous compositions in classical music history.

audio.title: Franz Schubert - Ave Maria (Orchestral Instrumental)
audio.body: Stream the historical instrumental classical recording of Ellens dritter Gesang, popularly referred to as Schubert's Ave Maria, composed originally in 1825.

video.title: Big Buck Bunny - Open Source Cinema Project
video.body: Watch the famous full-length animated short film created entirely with open-source software by the Blender Foundation. Features high-definition canvas playback frames.

video.title: Sintel - Open Movie Project (Blender Animation)
video.body: Stream the cinematic fantasy short film 'Sintel', produced as an open-source creative project showcasing advanced computer graphic rendering techniques.

general.title: Python (Programming Language) Documentation
general.body: Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language. Its design philosophy emphasizes code readability with the use of significant indentation.

general.title: Flask (Web Framework) Essentials
general.body: Flask is a micro web framework written in Python. It is classified as a microframework because it does not require particular tools or libraries.
